title: A novel ene-reductase from Halomonas elongata for flow biocatalytic synthesis of 3-phenylpropionaldehyde and sustainable indigo-carmine dyeing
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43974-43982
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06869J, Paper
Open Access

Lauriane Pillet, Cristina Lía Fernández Reguerio, Markus Richard Busch, David Roura Padrosa, Francesca Paradisi
The characterization of novel ene-reductases identifies a halophilic enzyme with remarkable catalytic efficiency. HeOYE could be successfully immobilised for process intensification and applied in a tandem cascade for the synthesis of leuco-indigo. The image was created in full using Bria AI.
